name: Terminal
description: An integrated shell, in a real PTY (cross-platform — ConPTY on Windows, a native pty everywhere else). Vendors @xterm/xterm, see XTERM_LICENSE.

settings.label: Shell command
settings.hint: Command used to launch a new terminal. Default is PowerShell on Windows, $SHELL elsewhere. Anything on your PATH works, e.g. pwsh, bash, zsh, cmd.

settings.label: Font size
settings.hint: Applies to new terminals opened after this is changed, not ones already open.

settings.label: Scrollback (lines)
settings.hint: How many lines of output each terminal keeps for scrolling back. Applies to new terminals opened after this is changed.

commands.label: Terminal: New Terminal
commands.hint: Opens a new terminal instance using your configured (or default) shell.
